integrity_notes: Exact algebraic and analytic rational-inequality proof supplied. Symbolic and finite numerical checks corroborate, but a finite comparison is not a global proof. No independent mathematical validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies to exactly two equal-weight real value observations in an interval H^2 space with zero Lebesgue mean and zero first moment. Alternative complements, weights, orders or node counts remain untreated. A historical equivalent not indexed in accessible references cannot be excluded.
title: Unique symmetric minimax pair for moment-centred second-order Sobolev evaluation
